verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Oneleet integrations monitoring user accounts and access in GitHub, Google Workspace and AWS IAM. It also shows Fieldwork agents collecting evidence on a schedule. Neither documents an access review feature: no periodic review campaigns across connected apps, no in-app reviewer sign-off, and no review artifact filed into an evidence library. Access monitoring and generic evidence collection are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a security engineer, periodic user access reviews run across connected apps in the platform — reviewers sign off in-app and the artifact lands in the evidence library
